A circular life cycle diagram of a Liver Fluke. Top: A sheep (primary host) grazing. Arrow from sheep points right to "Eggs passed in faeces". Arrow points down to a swimming ciliated "Miracidium". Arrow points left into a "Water snail" (secondary host). Inside a call-out box for the snail, show text: "Sporocyst -> Redia -> Cercaria". Arrow points up from snail showing a swimming tadpole-like "Cercaria". Arrow points to a blade of grass showing round cysts. Final arrow points from the grass back to the grazing sheep. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A circular life cycle diagram of a Tapeworm. Top: A human (primary host). Arrow pointing right shows "Gravid proglottids containing eggs passed in faeces". Arrow points down to a pig (secondary host) eating contaminated food. Inside the pig, text reads: "Eggs hatch -> embryos migrate to muscle". Arrow points left to a slice of meat showing small white cysts,. Arrow points up to the human eating the meat,. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
